title: 河岸剪力的尺度~Scales of bank shear
formula: rho=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; R=0.8 m; S=0.003 dimensionless; tau=rho*g*R*S=23.544 Pa
boundary: 假設定常近均勻流，結果是平均邊界剪力，不是外彎岸坡最大剪力或植物耐受值~Assumes steady approximately uniform flow; the result is average boundary stress, not maximum outer-bank stress or plant resistance

title: 植生莖叢的阻力~Drag on vegetation stems
formula: rho=1000 kg/m3; Cd=1.1 dimensionless; A=1.2 m2; v=2 m/s; F=0.5*rho*Cd*A*v^2=2640 N
boundary: 固定投影面積與阻力係數的準定常示例，未模擬彎伏、波動或群生效應~A quasi-steady example with fixed projected area and drag coefficient, excluding reconfiguration, fluctuations and group effects

title: 根系補強的有效面積~Effective area in root reinforcement
formula: Tr=1600 N; As=0.2 m2; dc=Tr/As/1000=8 kPa
boundary: 有效拉力已假設包含方向與動員折減，僅代表指定剪面之附加應力~Effective tension already includes assumed orientation and mobilization reductions; the result applies only to the specified shear surface

title: 木構護岸的浮力~Buoyancy of wood revetments
formula: rhow=1000 kg/m3; rhol=600 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; V=0.8 m3; Fu=(rhow-rhol)*g*V=3139.2 N
boundary: 完全浸沒且密度均勻，僅計靜水淨上浮力，不是錨具額定需求~Fully submerged uniform density; calculates net hydrostatic uplift only, not an anchorage rating

title: 岸趾埋深與沖刷餘量~Toe embedment and erosion allowance
formula: e=1.2 m; ds=0.5 m; er=e-ds=0.7 m
boundary: 同一垂直基準的幾何差值，沒有將剩餘埋深換算成穩定安全係數~A geometric difference on one vertical datum, without converting remaining embedment into a stability factor

title: 建立期植株存活率~Plant survival during establishment
formula: N0=240 plants; Ns=180 plants; ps=Ns/N0=0.75 dimensionless
boundary: 固定原始植株群的觀察比例，不含補植且不是抗剪能力比例~Observed proportion of the fixed original cohort, excluding replacements and not representing a shear strength ratio

title: 纖維毯搭接與淨覆蓋~Mat overlap and effective coverage
formula: N=6 strips; w=2 m; o=0.2 m; L=20 m; Ac=(N*w-(N-1)*o)*L=220 m2
boundary: 平面平行條帶僅計五道縱向搭接，未扣端部與曲面裁切~Parallel planar strips with five longitudinal overlaps only; excludes end anchorage and curved trimming

title: 退水期孔隙水壓~Pore pressure during drawdown
formula: gammaw=9.81 kN/m3; dh=2 m; du=gammaw*dh=19.62 kPa
boundary: 同一高程兩點之靜水壓差示例，不求解非定常滲流或整體穩定~Illustrates hydrostatic pressure difference at one elevation, without solving transient seepage or overall stability

title: 泥砂通量的護岸檢核~Sediment flux around bank treatments
formula: Qin=0.08 m3/s; Cin=0.12 kg/m3; Qout=0.075 m3/s; Cout=0.07 kg/m3; dt=3600 s; dM=(Qin*Cin-Qout*Cout)*dt=15.66 kg
boundary: 一小時定常且無側向泥砂通量，所得為控制體暫存，不能直接宣稱永久去除~Steady one-hour interval without lateral sediment flux; result is control-volume storage, not demonstrated permanent removal

title: 對照監測的生態成效~Ecological outcomes with comparison monitoring
formula: T0=35 percent; T1=70 percent; C0=40 percent; C1=55 percent; effect=(T1-T0)-(C1-C0)=20 percentage-points
boundary: 示範差中之差，因果解釋仍需平行趨勢與不受干擾的對照~Illustrates difference in differences; causal interpretation still requires parallel trends and an unaffected comparison

title: 落差配置與縱坡~Drop spacing and longitudinal slope
formula: dz=0.6 m; S0=0.012 dimensionless; Se=0.004 dimensionless; L=dz/(S0-Se)=75 m
boundary: 均一坡度的幾何初估，不是最適間距或平衡坡保證~Geometric screening with uniform slopes, not an optimal spacing or guarantee of equilibrium

title: 斷面比能的兩種流態~Specific energy and alternate depths
boundary: 矩形斷面、速度分布係數取一且近似靜水壓，未包含局部損失~Rectangular section with unit velocity correction and approximately hydrostatic pressure, excluding local losses

title: 臨界水深與控制斷面~Critical depth and control sections
boundary: 矩形斷面之臨界水深，不能直接套用梯形斷面或淹沒控制~Critical depth for a rectangular section, not directly transferable to trapezoidal sections or drowned controls

title: 水躍共軛水深~Conjugate depths of a hydraulic jump
boundary: 水平矩形短水躍，未給消能池長度且忽略外加阻力~Short hydraulic jump in a horizontal rectangular reach, without basin length or external resisting forces

title: 護坦揚壓與排水~Apron uplift and drainage
formula: pu=30 kPa; pd=10 kPa; B=4 m; L=6 m; U=0.5*(pu+pd)*B*L=480 kN
boundary: 給定的是板底淨向上壓力且沿長度線性變化，未檢查板彎曲~Specified values are net upward pressures varying linearly along length; slab bending is not checked

title: 顆粒起動與希爾茲參數~Grain motion and Shields parameter
formula: tau=40 Pa; rhos=2650 kg/m3; rhow=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; d=0.05 m; theta=tau/((rhos-rhow)*g*d)=0.0494239 dimensionless
boundary: 只計非黏性顆粒之無因次應力，沒有指定通用起動門檻~Calculates dimensionless stress for noncohesive grains without specifying a universal entrainment threshold

title: 濾層粒徑的相容比較~Filter grading compatibility
formula: D15=2 mm; d85=0.5 mm; Rg=D15/d85=4 dimensionless
boundary: 純級配比值示例，不宣稱四就是任意基土之合格門檻~A grading ratio example only; four is not asserted as an acceptance threshold for arbitrary soils

title: 河床泥砂收支~Bed sediment continuity
formula: Qsi=0.001 m3/s solids; Qso=0.0015 m3/s solids; dt=86400 s; p=0.35 dimensionless; B=12 m; L=80 m; dz=(Qsi-Qso)*dt/((1-p)*B*L)=-0.0692308 m
boundary: 固體體積通量且無側向輸砂，負值代表控制體平均侵蝕~Solid-volume transport without lateral sediment exchange; negative change denotes mean control-volume erosion

title: 塊石浸水重量~Submerged weight of loose rock
boundary: 完全浸沒理想球體的重量尺度，未計升力、拖曳或互鎖~Submerged ideal-sphere weight scale, excluding lift, drag and interlocking

title: 遷移陡坎的追蹤~Tracking migrating bed steps
formula: x0=350 m downstream-chainage; x1=295 m downstream-chainage; dt=5 year; vu=(x0-x1)/dt=11 m/year upstream
boundary: 相同陡坎之期間平均向上游速率，不是未來事件預測~Interval-average upstream rate for the same bed step, not a forecast of future events

title: 池間落差與射流~Pool drops and jet velocity
boundary: 忽略損失的局部速度尺度，不是魚種可通過限值或池內平均流速~Local ideal velocity scale without losses, not a species passage limit or pool average

title: 開口流量與係數~Opening discharge and coefficient
formula: Cd=0.7 dimensionless; b=0.2 m; h=0.8 m; g=9.81 m/s2; dh=0.15 m; Q=Cd*b*h*sqrt(2*g*dh)=0.192138 m3/s
boundary: 完全淹沒開口與給定有效係數，未把係數當通用常數~Fully submerged opening with an assumed effective coefficient, not a universal coefficient

title: 池體積與平均能量密度~Pool volume and mean energy density
boundary: 假設該水頭功率全在所列池容內耗散，非魚種允許值~Assumes the head power dissipates within the stated pool volume; not a species acceptance limit

title: 游泳速度與地面進度~Swimming speed and ground progress
formula: Us=1.2 m/s upstream-relative-water; U=0.8 m/s downstream; L=6 m; t=L/(Us-U)=15 s
boundary: 一維定常逆流與固定可維持游速，未包括轉向與疲勞~One-dimensional steady counterflow with fixed sustainable swimming speed, excluding turns and fatigue

title: 入口誘導流量比例~Attraction flow proportion
formula: Qa=0.6 m3/s; Qr=40 m3/s; fa=Qa/Qr=0.015 dimensionless
boundary: 僅為指定時刻水量比例，不是普遍建議值或吸引成功率~A discharge fraction at one specified time, not a universal recommendation or attraction success rate

title: 水池換水與魚類停留~Water turnover and fish residence
boundary: 名義水體換水尺度，未假設每隻魚或每個水粒子停留二十秒~Nominal water turnover scale, without assuming every fish or water particle remains twenty seconds

title: 篩網接近速度比較~Screen approach velocity comparison
formula: Q=0.9 m3/s; Ag=3 m2; phi=0.6 dimensionless; vp=Q/(Ag*phi)=0.5 m/s
boundary: 均勻法向通流的孔隙平均速度，不與總網面表觀接近速度混稱~Mean opening velocity for uniform normal flow, distinct from gross-area superficial approach velocity

title: 渦流尺度與魚體尺度~Eddy scales and fish size
formula: ell=0.4 m; uprime=0.2 m/s; te=ell/uprime=2 s
boundary: 量綱尺度估算，非完整紊流頻譜或魚類生理反應模型~Dimensional scale estimate, not a complete turbulence spectrum or physiological response model

title: 偵測效率與通過比例~Detection efficiency and passage proportion
formula: Nu=80 fish; pu=0.8 dimensionless; Nd=100 fish; pd=0.9 dimensionless; phat=(Nu/pu)/(Nd/pd)=0.9 dimensionless
boundary: 同一族群唯一個體計數與已知偵測機率的簡化估計，不含估計不確定性~Simplified same-cohort unique-count estimator with known detection probabilities, excluding estimation uncertainty

title: 多段通行的累積效果~Cumulative passage across reaches
formula: p=0.9 dimensionless conditional-stage-probability; N=5 stages; Pall=p^N=0.59049 dimensionless
boundary: 五段條件通過率皆給定相同值；若視為邊際率則另需獨立性假設~All five conditional stage probabilities are assumed equal; using marginal rates instead would additionally require independence

title: 蜿蜒度與量測尺度~Sinuosity and measurement scale
formula: Lc=1800 m; Lv=1200 m; P=Lc/Lv=1.5 dimensionless
boundary: 相同起訖點與固定中心線定義，只描述平面長度比~Matching endpoints and a fixed centreline definition; describes plan-length ratio only

title: 展長後的平均坡度~Mean slope after lengthening
formula: dz=3 m; L=1800 m; S=dz/L=0.001666667 dimensionless
boundary: 固定兩端床高的平均幾何坡度，不代替局部能坡或輸砂平衡~Mean geometric slope at fixed endpoint bed levels, not local energy slope or sediment equilibrium

title: 粗糙度與通水尺度~Roughness and conveyance scale
boundary: SI 曼寧形式的近均勻流示例，能坡為獨立假設且非前單元床坡~SI Manning approximation for near-uniform flow; energy slope is independently assumed, not the preceding unit's bed slope

title: 洪氾地的可用蓄水~Available floodplain storage
boundary: 指定水位下新增平均水深且無既存積水，不推算洪峰削減~Added mean depth at a specified stage with no pre-existing water; peak reduction is not inferred

title: 彎道橫向水面差~Transverse water level in bends
boundary: 小寬徑比與代表平均速度的尺度估算，未解析二次流~Scale estimate using modest width-to-radius ratio and representative mean velocity, without resolving secondary circulation

title: 岸線遷移與土方體積~Bank migration and eroded volume
formula: L=240 m; r=2.5 m; H=1.8 m; Ve=L*r*H=1080 m3 in-place
boundary: 均勻矩形岸塊幾何估算，未轉成固體質量或下游輸砂量~Uniform rectangular bank-block estimate, not converted to solid mass or downstream sediment export

title: 側汊連通的交換水量~Exchange volume through a side channel
formula: Q=0.8 m3/s into-side-channel; dt=7200 s; Vin=Q*dt=5760 m3
boundary: 定常向內流量之總流入體積，不等於淨蓄水或削峰量~Gross inflow volume during steady inward flow, not net storage or peak attenuation

title: 河岸地下水交換~Groundwater exchange across banks
boundary: 飽和均質一維定常達西流，水頭差方向已指定~Saturated homogeneous one-dimensional steady Darcy flow with a specified head-gradient direction

title: 水體平移與洪波傳播~Water advection and flood-wave travel
boundary: 定常均速平流時間尺度，不是洪峰傳播或完整示蹤停留分布~Steady uniform advection scale, not flood-peak travel or a full tracer residence distribution

title: 地形差分的量測不確定性~Uncertainty in terrain differences
boundary: 兩期獨立零均值隨機誤差的差分標準差，非自動的可信界限~Difference standard deviation for independent zero-mean random errors, not an automatic confidence bound

title: 集合超越機率~Ensemble exceedance probability
formula: Ne=8 members above-threshold; N=20 equally-weighted-members; p=Ne/N=0.4 dimensionless
boundary: 等權情境的經驗比例，非已驗證校準之真實洪水機率~Empirical fraction of equally weighted scenarios, not a demonstrated calibrated probability of flooding

title: 分位數與有限成員~Quantiles with finite ensembles
formula: ordered-flows=[80,100,120,140,160] m3/s; q=0.9 dimensionless; h=(5-1)*q=3.6 zero-based-rank; Qq=140+0.6*(160-140)=152 m3/s
boundary: 指定線性插值經驗分位數，五個成員不能證明尾部分布校準~Specified linearly interpolated empirical quantile; five members do not establish tail calibration

title: 機率預報的布里爾分數~Brier score for probability forecasts
formula: probabilities=[0.2,0.7,0.6,0.1] dimensionless; outcomes=[0,1,1,0] binary; BS=(0.2^2+(0.7-1)^2+(0.6-1)^2+0.1^2)/4=0.075 dimensionless
boundary: 四筆獨立保留樣本的示範平均，不代表已完成長期服務驗證~Illustrative average for four held-out cases, not validation of a long-term forecasting service

title: 水庫時段水量守恆~Reservoir interval water balance
boundary: 時段流量線性變化且無其他水量項，僅求庫容增量~Linearly changing flows without other water terms; calculates storage increment only

title: 匯流點的同步疊加~Aligned flows at a junction
formula: QAarr=120 m3/s; QBarr=80 m3/s; Qtarr=60 m3/s; Qj=QAarr+QBarr+Qtarr=260 m3/s
boundary: 三股流量已演算至同一匯流斷面同一時刻，未在此假設原始洩流同步~All contributions are routed to the same junction and instant; upstream releases are not assumed simultaneous here

title: 下游剩餘通洪額度~Residual downstream flow allowance
formula: Qlim=300 m3/s; Qtrib=90 m3/s; Qother=70 m3/s; Qallow=Qlim-Qtrib-Qother=140 m3/s
boundary: 給定假想斷面限制與同步到達流量，不是實際核准洩流量~Hypothetical section limit with aligned arriving flows, not an authorized reservoir release

title: 預洩所需時間窗~Time window for prerelease
formula: Vtarget=1800000 m3; Qnetextra=50 m3/s; t=Vtarget/Qnetextra/3600=10 h
boundary: 額外淨釋放已扣相對基準入流變化，假設可持續且無爬升時間~Additional net release already accounts for inflow change relative to baseline, assuming sustained feasibility and no ramp time

title: 不相容操作限制~Incompatible operating constraints
boundary: 正缺口表示所給同時限制無交集，未自動放寬任何規則~A positive gap means the simultaneous stated bounds have no intersection; no rule is automatically relaxed

title: 情境違反率與風險~Scenario violation rate and risk
formula: Nv=3 violating-scenarios; N=50 equally-weighted-scenarios; pv=Nv/N=0.06 dimensionless
boundary: 等權情境違反比例，沒有將百分之六宣稱成核准風險或真實機率~Equally weighted scenario violation fraction, not an approved risk level or established true probability

title: 預報改善與獨立驗證~Forecast improvement and independent validation
formula: model-errors=[12,8,20,4] m3/s; reference-errors=[20,15,25,12] m3/s; MAE=44/4=11 m3/s; MAEref=72/4=18 m3/s; skill=1-MAE/MAEref=0.388889 dimensionless
boundary: 同四筆保留樣本與正參考誤差，改善尺度不等於風險降低百分比~Same four held-out cases with positive reference error; skill is not a percentage reduction in operational risk
